props.gloss_en: the mishnah: or if he cut them [the trellised plants] -- kesheira
'or if he cut them, kesheira' -- and one must shake them [after cutting]
Rav Huna: Rav validates [the sukkah by the cutting alone]
as in the case of Rav Amram the Pious, who put tekhelet on the garment of his household: he hung them and did not cut the ends of their threads; he came before Rav Chiyya bar Ashi
thus said Rav: he cuts them [apart] and they are valid
evidently: their cutting is their making
here too [of the trellised plants]: their cutting is their making
(the stam's presupposition) Shmuel holds we do not say their cutting is their making
if he put [the threads] on two corners at once and afterwards cut the ends of their threads -- they are valid
no: [the baraita speaks of one] who cuts and afterwards ties
lest you say we require [a single] corner at the time of the threading, and there is none -- it teaches us [that it is not required]
if he hung them and did not cut the ends of their threads -- they are invalid
Rav can say to you: what is 'invalid'? invalid until they are cut
and Shmuel said: invalid forever
Rav Matna: the case happened to me, and I came before Mar Shmuel, and he said to me: invalid forever
if he hung them and afterwards cut the ends of their threads -- they are invalid
and it is taught of the sukkah: 'you shall make' -- and not from what is [already] made
from here they said: if he trained the vine, the gourd and the ivy over it and roofed on top of them -- it is invalid
(candidate) the baraita speaks of one who did not cut them
(survivor) rather, of one who cut them -- and it teaches 'invalid'
if he transgressed and picked them -- invalid; the words of R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak
and the Sages validate
(they supposed) all agree the lulav requires binding
(they supposed) and we learn lulav from sukkah, for it is written of sukkah: 'you shall make' -- and not from what is made
(entertained) the tannaim dispute this: the validator holds that of sukkah we say their cutting is their making, and of lulav their picking is their making; the invalidator holds we do not
no: all agree that of sukkah we do not say their cutting is their making
and here they dispute learning lulav from sukkah: the validator holds we do not learn lulav from sukkah, the invalidator that we do
or say: if we hold the lulav requires binding, all agree we learn lulav from sukkah; here they dispute this: one holds it requires binding, the other that it does not
a lulav, whether bound or not bound -- valid
R' Yehuda: bound -- valid; not bound -- invalid
and the Rabbis: we do not learn 'taking' from 'taking'
a lulav -- it is a mitzva to bind it
and if he did not bind it -- valid
(candidate) the baraita is R' Yehuda's
(survivor) actually, it is the Rabbis'
and [the mitzva to bind is] because it is said 'this is my God and I will glorify Him' (Shemot 15:2) -- beautify yourself before Him in mitzvot

eliminated_by.gloss_en: אי רבי יהודה, כי לא אגדו אמאי כשר? -- for him an unbound lulav is invalid
אי רבנן, אמאי מצוה? -- for them binding is not required at all

rebuffed_by.gloss_en: לעולם רבנן היא, ומשום שנאמר זה אלי ואנוהו -- התנאה לפניו במצות: the mitzva is beautification, not a condition of validity (= p_ze_eli_veanvehu)

challenges.gloss_en: אלא בשקצצן, וקתני פסולה, ושמע מינה דלא אמרינן קציצתן זו היא עשייתן, ותיובתא דרב!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב: הכא במאי עסקינן -- דשלפינהו שלופי, דלא מינכרא עשיה דידהו: he pulled them off, so their making is not noticeable

challenges.gloss_en: מכל מקום, תלאן ואחר כך פסק קשיא לרב! קשיא -- the 11b.4 baraita (= p_baraita_tlaan_veachar_kach: hung and then cut, invalid) stands against Rav's מפסקן והן כשרין

objections.gloss_en: והא תני שמואל משום רבי חייא: הטיל לשני קרנות בבת אחת ואחר כך פסק -- כשרין; מאי לאו שקושר ואחר כך פוסק! -- Shmuel's own baraita validates cutting after [tying]

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, שפוסק ואחר כך קושר -- he cut and then tied (= p_okimta_posek_vekosher)

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי: תלאן ולא פסק ראשי חוטין שלהן -- פסולין. מאי לאו פסולין לעולם, ותיובתא דרב?

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב: מאי פסולין -- פסולין עד שיפסקו (= p_pesulin_ad_sheyipaseku)
